emma_sales: Quick heads-up 1 EnterpriseNova gave verbal OK pending POC. They need a clear capacity plan (reserved vs burst), three pricing scenarios, and security language for bursts. Can infra / SRE / finance triage here?

diego_se: Nice. Do we have the traffic profile and model choice yet?

emma_sales: From their presales doc: baseline ~200 qps, sporadic spikes up to ~1200 qps lasting 3-8 minutes, avg tokens/request ~200, target p95 latency <500ms. Primary model: llama-large-v2, customer is open to 8-bit quant if quality checks pass.

anya_infra: TL;DR: recommend reserve for baseline+buffer and metered burst capacity for spikes. Back-of-envelope numbers: llama-large-v2 fp16 -> ~100 qps/node (mx-large/A100-equivalent). 8-bit quant -> ~140 qps/node. With kv-cache warmed you can shave ~25% of effective load for prefix-heavy traffic.

anya_infra: So options: reserve 3 nodes (8-bit -> covers ~420 qps warmed; with cache that hits baseline comfortably), autoscale up to 13 nodes for 1200 qps peaks. If they want stronger baseline SLAs, reserve 6 nodes and smaller burst headroom.

mike_sre: Ops notes: preheat is critical. If bursts are predictable run a preheat replay 10-12 minutes before window. For unpredictable spikes rely on autoscale + burst credits. Also add degraded-mode fallback (shorter context or smaller model) to protect p95 on overload.

diego_se: Any example autoscale policy we can show in the POC?

mike_sre: Yep, drop into the playbook. Fast scale-up, slow scale-down, healthcheck before sending traffic back.

mike_sre: ```
policy:
  metrics: [gpu_util, queue_latency]
  scale_up:
    trigger: gpu_util > 75% OR queue_latency > 150ms
    step: +3 nodes
    cooldown_s: 45
  scale_down:
    trigger: gpu_util < 40% AND queue_latency < 80ms
    step: -1 node
    cooldown_s: 900
fallbacks:
  - name: degraded-small-8bit
    max_qps: 350
    downgrade_on: p95_latency > 700ms
```

anya_infra: Preheat command we use in infra-runbooks (replays representative prompts):
```
python tools/preheat.py --profile enterprise-nova --qps 150 --duration 600 --prompt-set prompts/enterprise-nova.json
```
This warms KV cache and registers tokens in the KV quickly.

helen_finance: Pricing: I'll prepare three scenarios for the quote deck:
- Option 1: Minimal reserve (3 nodes) + PAYG bursts (metered per-node-minute)
- Option 2: Mid reserve (6 nodes) with lower unit rate + included burst minutes per month, overage PAYG
- Option 3: Dedicated VPC package (reserved nodes in customer VPC) with flat monthly and negotiated SLA (higher price)
I'll need expected burst frequency (# of 3-8m bursts per week) to model monthly cost.

diego_se: They said "a few times per week" but will confirm cadence on the call tomorrow.

anya_infra: Security wording for questionnaire: Hosted offering is SOC2 Type II, supports customer-managed KMS for keys at rest, and data residency controls via region pinning. Note: hosted burst capacity may execute on multi-tenant GPU pools unless customer selects Dedicated or Private. If isolation for bursts is required, recommend Dedicated nodes in their VPC for both baseline and burst pools.

helen_finance: Flag: Dedicated + reserved burst capacity will increase MRR substantially. I'll include a delta table and %increase for each option.

emma_sales: Good. Anything else for legal/security to sign off?

mike_sre: Include a short failover play: region fallback (if primary AZ degraded) + automatic model degrade policy. Also include expected cold-start penalty table (tokens/sec and latency delta for cold vs warm caches). That helps legal understand risk.

anya_infra: Quick cold-start note to include: cold cache can add ~200-400ms extra p95 on first few minutes of a burst depending on prompt reuse. With preheat we reduce that to single-digit ms added.

infra-bot: ticket created INF-8044: enterprise-nova-preheat-capacity-playbook. Assigned to anya_infra.

helen_finance: Action items: I'll produce the three pricing scenarios and delta table by EOD tomorrow once Diego confirms burst frequency.

anya_infra: Action items: I'll run exact node-count perf tests for llama-large-v2 fp16 and 8-bit on mx-large and post numbers to INF-8044. Will include cache-warm vs cold metrics.

mike_sre: Action items: I'll author the autoscale + failover snippets and the preheat job example into the playbook and attach to INF-8044.

emma_sales: I'll get burst cadence and representative prompt set from the customer on tomorrow's sync. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
